schema: studio-full-kit-export-ledger/1 (planning addendum; not the frozen inventory, profile or export contract)
status: PROPOSAL for root disposition before M3 execution. Frozen inventory/profile unchanged. No geometry, batching or export implemented by this ledger.
author: Claude (actual), task_e0a4ef11c0ca / ctx_c777d3962014, 2026-11-15

accountingModel.perLeaf: p = 2 for double-sided BLEND (three r187 WebGLRenderer two-pass, forceSinglePass false), else 1; s = 1 for a caster under the single directional PCF shadow, else 0
accountingModel.refreshCalls: sum(p + s) + explicitly identified extra renderer passes (none identified for this rig)
accountingModel.culling: no culling credit; all leaves assumed visible and inside the light frustum
accountingModel.retainedRows: M1/M2 rows copied leaf by leaf from the independent review JSON, which matches v02 and v03 byte for byte
accountingModel.uniqueTriangles: counted once per glTF mesh; baked same-asset families are unique == placed
accountingModel.runtimeNonKitDraws: assumed 0 (current sample 131 = 83 settled + 48 casters decomposes exactly into kit leaves); root confirms in production capture

hardGates.render: demand render at current DPR caps

rejected: The art-direction 70-main-pass / 130-peak-call complete-room forecast and all zero-draw / linkedInstances multiplications are rejected and replaced by this ledger; no waiver is implied.
